notes.title: Profiles Update: Link Crosshairs and Keybinds to Games Easily!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re back with a highly anticipated update that finally brings [b]Profiles[/b] to Crosshair X. 

[h2]📁 What is a Profile?[/h2]
A [b]Profile[/b] is a bundle of settings you save for a game or app. It includes:
[list]
[*] Default crosshair (used when the profile loads)
[*] Keybinds
[*] Position and size settings
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/f8ac0fa97b0adb26ffda808d4242349515cdd2d5.png[/img]

[b]Important:[/b] To change your profile settings, just set it as active and make any changes within Crosshair X — they’ll be saved automatically!



[h2]✨ New Profiles Page[/h2]
[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Create new profiles for each game or app
[*] Attach profiles to apps for automatic switching
[*] Manage all your saved profiles in one place
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/53aded746f0157d966c5a2bb4294dbfe19e1e258.png[/img]




[h2]🎯 App-Specific Crosshairs[/h2]
You can now set your crosshair to only appear in the app you choose! Attach a profile to an application, and Crosshair X will automatically show or hide the crosshair based on which app you’re using.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/f6dd899b30f5be3b9a3ec773e19a45169165ad79.gif[/img]
(Keep an eye out for the green controller indicator)




[h2]🔍 Profile Detection[/h2]
Profile Detection automatically switches to the right profile when you use a linked app. If you’ve set up a profile for that app, Crosshair X will load it automatically!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/6c505055107168678483cd2d6fc520e1f2325b56.gif[/img]



[h2]🛠️ Additional Changes[/h2]
[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an indicator for the current profile in the top bar.
[*] Added Profile selector to the "Keybinds" page.
[*] Added Profile selector to the "Positon & Size" page.
[*] Added global setting for "Profile Detection".
[/list]



[h2] 👋 That's everything [/h2]

Thanks for all your support — Hope you enjoy the new update and we’re excited to celebrate our 5-year anniversary with you in June!  

— Crosshair X Team 🦆

notes.title: Designer Upgrade: More Animation Settings, and More Control
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're beginning to focus on improving our designer and give you all the best set of tools out there —this one’s all about unlocking your creativity and giving you more control than ever before.

[h2]🔤 Rename Your Layers[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now rename a layer by clicking the name of the layer you have selected.
[*] To remove a name, simply delete the text and click outside the input box.
[*] Layers now highlight on hover without needing to select, making it easier to know what you're about to click.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/97eed1af17163363835077e5ebd661ecb4db181f.gif[/img]


[h2]🎬 Animate Everything[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/86e818fefd9deb7abc7ac02e9f1e0d21a367dbda.gif[/img]

[*] "Inwards" and "Outwards" modifiers replaced by Line "Gap" animation setting.

  [*] "Opacity" now controlled per Line, Outline, and Center Dot animation settings.

  [*] The Line "Visible" animation setting lets you choose which lines appear or disappear at the end of the animation (defaults to the current Visible value set in the Line settings tab).

notes.title: Holiday Theme, Improvements and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The holidays are here, and we couldn’t be more excited to share our festive update with you! This release is packed with some shiny new features, including a revamped Display Modes page, enhanced Streamer Settings, and more surprises to unwrap.

As the year comes to a close, we want to take a moment to thank you all for an incredible 2024. Your feedback has driven some of our biggest improvements—like the Keybinds system and the Designer upgrades—and we’re already looking ahead to 2025 with even bigger plans.

During the holiday season, we’d love to hear from you! Share your ideas and suggestions, and help us make the app even better in the new year.

Now, let’s dive into the details of this festive update!


[h1]🎄Holiday Theme[/h1]
To get you into the holiday spirit, we’ve given the app a festive makeover! You’ll notice rope lights, candy cane-inspired accents, and a sprinkle of snow to set the perfect winter vibe. We hope this update adds a little extra cheer to your season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/4e28f774b9aef2035455df5835f053d8d7e182f2.png[/img]
And don’t worry—if festive isn’t your thing, you can easily [b]toggle the holiday theme on or off from the Options page[/b].


In addition to this, we’ve added a "Happy Holidays" tab to the sidebar -- You can check out [b]the winners of our Festive Crosshair Contest that was hosted on our Discord[/b]. The creativity from our community blew us away, and we’re excited to showcase their holiday-themed designs!

If you don’t want to miss out on future giveaways, contests, and more, be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/customcrosshair]Join our Discord[/url]! It’s the best place to stay in the loop, share your ideas, and connect with other crosshair enthusiasts.


[h1]✨ More Featured Crosshairs! [/h1]
We’ve also expanded our crosshair collection with even more options for newly featured games like CS2 and Valorant. Thanks to your feedback, we’ve added a variety of new styles to help you find the perfect fit.

And for our CS2 players, we’re excited to introduce spray pattern crosshairs—a game-changer for mastering your recoil control! Be sure to check them out and let us know what you think.


[h1]🎮 Game Bar Health Check Revamp[/h1]
We’ve given the Game Bar page a major overhaul to make setup smoother and faster than ever. You’ll now see the setup status directly on the main page, so you can easily check that everything’s ready to go for Game Bar mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/bc6758ce78e4f4f4f3a831bd8712cfdbd15941a3.png[/img]

But that’s not all—[b]we’ve also added the ability to launch Crosshair X + Game Bar with a single button click[/b]. This is a HUGE quality-of-life improvement for those who already have everything set up, letting you jump straight into the action with no extra steps.


[h1]🎥 Calling all Streamers![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/45743cbe986fc329de6f1a7e00bfb47b393910b7.gif[/img]

We’ve revamped the Recording/Streaming Options page to provide more helpful tools and guidance for setting up your stream or recording with Crosshair X. Plus, we’ve added downloadable assets to enhance your stream and show off your support. Join our growing content creator community and help us expand our reach!

In addition, for those who use our Streamer Server feature. There is now a guided health check to help you get setup!


Thanks for reading, and we hope you enjoy the Festive Update! As always, we’d love to hear your feedback—join the conversation, share your holiday-themed crosshairs, and let us know what you think.

Wishing you a joyful holiday season,
The Crosshair X Team 🎄🎁

(Comment “It’s time to deck the balls” if you made it this far!)

notes.title: New Designer, Search Page and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’re thrilled to share our latest major update with you—the [b]Designer 2 and Search[/b] Update. This one’s big, with a totally overhauled Designer packed full of new tools and features to give you even more control over your crosshairs. Plus, we’ve made finding community-made crosshairs easier than ever with a brand-new Search tab. There’s a lot to cover, so let’s jump right in!

[h1]🔍 Search [/h1]
In case you missed it in our last update, we added a[b] Search feature to the Crosshairs page![/b] Now, you can browse the workshop, check out the most popular crosshairs, and try them out—all without leaving the page. We hope this makes it easier and more fun to explore the amazing creations shared by our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/42b1d6395b836b93fc0376f8ef20efd5a062228e.png[/img]


[h1]🎨 New Designer 2[/h1]
Meet the new [b]Designer[/b]—redesigned for better performance, intuitive controls, and more customization options. Continue reading for extensive list of whats new:

[h3]Layout [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/be611ecf78949fdae57174389481b5587bc2b424.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Improved Performance[/b]: Sliders now respond instantly, and lag issues have been eliminated.
[*][b]Resizable Zones[/b]: Adjust the size of the preview and layer manager sections to create a layout that works best for you.
[*][b]Tabbed Settings[/b]: Design settings are now grouped into easy-to-navigate tabs, making it faster to find and adjust settings like layers, animations, and visual properties.
[*][b]Tab Component Preview[/b]: Quickly see a visual representation of each layer component—lines, outlines, dots, animations, and more—directly within the settings tabs.
[/list]

[h3]Live Preview[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/5640abfca34f655433bce03108a788497f41c544.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Layer Highlighting[/b]: Easily identify the active layer you're working on with visual highlights.
[*][b] Animation Preview[/b]: See how your crosshair animations look inside the designer. To activate just click and hold your Aim / Fire key while in the designer.
[*][b] Zoom / Pan Controls[/b]: Easily adjust your view inside the designer by scrolling with your mouse mouse wheel to zoom or drag with left click to pan.
[/list]

[h3] Features [/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Undo / Redo [/b] - Easily step back or forward through your design changes with a full edit history.
[*][b]Multi-Layer Selection[/b] - Quickly Select all, specific, or a range of layers
[*][b]Multi-Layer Edits[/b] -  Apply color changes or adjust settings across multiple selected layers in one go
[*][b]Import Crosshairs[/b]: You can now combine designs effortlessly by importing another crosshair into your current project to create unique, customized masterpieces.
[*][b]Color Removal[/b]: Remove color from the center dot, outline, or lines to create unique effects, like fade-in animations or outline-only crosshairs.
[*][b]Save & Replace[/b]: Easily replace existing crosshairs when saving to keep your library clean and organized.
[/list]


[h3] Shortcuts [/h3]
[*] [b]Undo[/b]: CTRL + Z
[*] [b]Redo[/b]: CTRL + SHIFT + Z
[*] [b]Select All Layers[/b]: CTRL + A

notes.title: New Keybinds Page, Controller Support and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're excited to bring you another major update that we think you'll love. There's a lot to unpack in this announcement as we've introduced even more customization options to help you get the most out of Crosshair X.

One of the highlights of this update is a brand-new page where you can set your keybinds and tailor your Crosshair X experience to match your play style. We've also enhanced support for setting keybinds with controllers, along with several other UX improvements.

[h1]Keybinds Page[/h1]
Introducing the new Keybinds experience! With a familiar and intuitive UI, you can now easily set custom crosshair keybinds and update your aim and fire keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/466fcc5f52cfba2d83db1620e5ddb130d9b80426.png[/img]

Here you can set keybinds for:
[list]
[*] [b]Global Toggle[/b]: Set a keybind to toggle the visibility of your crosshair on or off. Whether you’re using a keyboard, or controller, you can customize this to your preference.
[*] [b]Aim[/b]: Assign a keybind for aiming, choosing from various inputs to ensure it feels natural whether you’re using a mouse or controller. Additionally, you can assign actions to be triggered when the aim key is pressed. More details on this below.
[*] [b]Fire[/b]: Set a keybind for firing. Again, this is customizable across different input devices, giving you full control over your gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/5f68b31c25d8c39a96e3385bf1034b377c4b0b06.png[/img]

[*] [b]Crosshairs[/b]: Assign keybinds to a saved crosshair. Easily switch between different crosshair styles with a simple key press.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/251ddbf3dea82498cdbbd5de2a18df7bfa0707de.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Controller Keybind Support[/h2]
Yep that's right! Crosshair X now supports Controller Input mapping. Now you can set controller mappings for crosshairs and even switch up the aim and fire keybinds if you’re one of those players who prefer not to use the triggers.  

Make sure to [b]enable "Controller Support" [/b] in the options!

[h2] Aim Keybind Actions[/h2]
We’ve integrated the settings from the "Toggle" page into a convenient dropdown menu. Now, you can assign a specific action to be triggered when the aim key is pressed, or choose to have no action at all.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/ec602cb99a834d5b4a28b836eac0ec2d11d616e4.png[/img]
[/list]
Supported "Aim" keybind actions:
[list]
[*] [b]No action[/b]: No additional action will be triggered when the aim key is pressed.
[*] [b]Toggle Crosshair (Press)[/b]: Pressing the aim key will toggle the visibility of the crosshair on and off.
[*] [b]Toggle Saved Crosshair (Press)[/b]: Pressing the aim key will toggle the visibility of a previously saved crosshair on and off.
[*] [b]Hide Crosshair (Hold)[/b]: Holding the aim key will hide the crosshair.
[*] [b]Show Crosshair (Hold)[/b]: Holding the aim key will display the crosshair.
[*] [b]Show Saved Crosshair (Hold)[/b]: Holding the aim key will display a previously saved crosshair.
[/list]

[h1]New Saved Crosshair Experience[/h1]
Save a crosshair with a single click! After saving, a message will appear, allowing you to explore other awesome crosshairs from our community. From this message you can:
[list]
[*] View Saved Crosshairs
[*] Open the crosshair in the Designer
[*] Create a keybind for the crosshair
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/5d6ed3ccf2977cff2dd17f42bfb50b008428d9ec.png[/img]

[h1]New Options Page[/h1]
We've refreshed the Options page to match the look and feel of our new Keybinds page, featuring a sleek tabular view. This update not only makes the app look more premium but also ensures a consistent user experience across all settings

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38447446/63002102699e1a03e866c3582bdb289643b6a1cc.png[/img]


[h1]Bug Fixes and More![/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue regarding page content not shifting when window is resized and navbar is collapsed
[*] New modal will appear when a setting is changed that requires app restart
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Complete Product Revamp

[h1]What comes next?[/h1]
This is really just the beginning of something great. We plan on expanding all of our key offerings such as the Community, the Designer, Hotkeys, etc in the near future so stay tuned!
